notice.title: Strict Prohibition of Child Marriage (बाल विवाह पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध)
notice.rule1: As per Child Marriage Prohibition Act 2006, child marriage is a punishable criminal offense.
notice.rule2: Marriage of girls under 18 years and boys under 21 years of age is strictly illegal.
notice.rule3: Child marriage is 100% prohibited in this temple. Anyone conducting or participating in child marriage is punishable with up to 2 years rigorous imprisonment or fine up to ₹ 1,00,000 or both.
notice.rule4: Anyone assisting or performing child marriage will face 2 years imprisonment and ₹ 1 Lakh penalty.
notice.rule5: To report child marriage immediately contact Helplines: Childline CHL=1098, Women Helpline WHL=181, Emergency Response ERSS=112.
notice.rule6: You may also inform District Child Protection Unit, Local Police Station, Gram Panchayat Secretary, Child Development Project Officer & District Program Officer.
notice.appeal: Cooperation of all devotees and visiting pilgrims is humbly requested in enforcing this law.
